title: She moves 300 sheep with just her eyes 🐕🐑
caption:
No barking. No biting. Just the stare 👀🐑
Tag a dog that's smarter than you 👇
sources: International Sheep Dog Society / The Kennel Club: Border Collies herd with 'eye' (a fixed stare and crouch) and respond to whistle commands (come-bye, away, lie down, walk on)
Strömbom D. et al. (2014) 'Solving the shepherding problem: heuristics for herding autonomous, interacting agents', Journal of the Royal Society Interface 11: 20140719
